guarantees.claim: On reset, key_state_q is cleared to 0 and key_state_ecc_q is cleared to TotalEccWords repetitions of SecdedInv7264ZeroEcc (all-zero ECC pattern).

When not in reset, on every positive clock edge key_state_ecc_q is updated by applying prim_secded_inv_72_64_enc to key_state_ecc_words_d for all CDIs, Shares, and EccWords indices. key_state_q is not updated.

assumptions.claim: key_state_ecc_words_d must be driven with valid (non-x) data every cycle.
assumptions.risk: Corrupted or unknown ECC values may be stored in key_state_ecc_q, potentially bypassing later integrity checks and leading to use of a corrupted key.

uncertain_points.claim: key_state_q is reset to zero but never updated after reset; it remains constant zero. This may be a dead signal or omitted assignment.
uncertain_points.risk: If key_state_q is intended to hold valid key material, it will be stuck at zero, causing incorrect key usage and potential security compromise.
